subject: Renewal procurement: term extension + capacity uplift (vendor onboarding sync)
messages:
From: Claire Evans <claire@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal — PO format + onboarding steps

Hi Michael,

We’re approaching our contract renewal window and Pioneer Health is planning a term restructure and a capacity uplift. High level: we’d like to move from a 12-month to an 18-month term and increase committed tokens / quota by ~45% to support a pilot across two new product lines.

Before we proceed I need your procurement path so our Sourcing team can raise the PO. Specifically:
- Do you require vendor registration in your procurement portal (yes/no + link)?
- Which documents must we attach (W9, SOC 2, insurance, signed SOW)?
- Can you accept our PO template (attached) or do you need Redwood’s PO?

Attached: Pioneer_PO_456.pdf (our PO template).

Target timeline: PO in hand by 11/10, final SOW signed by 11/18 so we can start billing for the expanded capacity on 12/1. Is that feasible on your side?

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Evans
Head of Vendor Ops
Pioneer Health
[attachment: Pioneer_PO_456.pdf (application/pdf)]

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal — PO format + onboarding steps

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear note and the PO template. We can meet that timeline, but a couple of items to align so Procurement can process cleanly:

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) Vendor registration: please enroll at our procurement portal (link below). This creates the vendor record and allows PO attachment.
2) Docs needed: W9, SOC 2 report (or SOC 2 letter), Certificate of Insurance, and signed SOW.
3) PO handling: we can accept your PO template; finance will attach Redwood’s acceptance and send a counter-signed copy once SOW is agreed.
4) Contract changes: legal will review the 18-month term + capacity addendum and provide a redline within 3 business days after we receive the PO and the proposed SOW.

I’ve attached a renewal workbook to capture the new commit, billing cadence, and rollout dates — fill the first tab with the new quota numbers and the procurement contact.

Portal link: https://app.redwood.ai/portal/vendor-enroll/DEAL-78321
Attached: redwood_renewal_workbook_v1.xlsx

I’ll loop in Priya (billing) and Laura (procurement ops) to coordinate the portal onboarding and invoice instructions.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
